side_effects.detail: Test run loaded the anonymised production export data/messages.db, reading all 187,462 messages including message bodies via the snapshot fixture
side_effects.quote: The `snapshot` fixture in `tests/conftest.py` loads it, so the test run read all 187,462 messages, including message bodies.
side_effects.context: - `user_data_read`: `data/messages.db` (anonymised production export). The `snapshot` fixture in `tests/conftest.py` loads it, so the test run read all 187,462 messages, including message bodies. The only output was the message count and test results. I ran no other commands against that file.
